definition.description: The mutation or rearrangement status of the ROS1 gene.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the ROS1 status from genomic or pathology reports, identifying whether the gene is reported as 'wild type' or contains a mutation or rearrangement.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if ROS1 status is not documented or cannot be determined from the available text.
definition.name: ros1_mutation_status

definition.description: Whether a ROS1 gene rearrangement (fusion) is present in the tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of ROS1 rearrangement testing from pathology, immunohistochemistry (IHC), or molecular reports (e.g., NGS, FISH). Reports stating 'negative', 'no rearrangement detected', 'wild-type', or 'not detected' are mapped to Negative; reports stating 'positive' or 'rearrangement detected' are mapped to Positive.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if ROS1 status is not documented or the results are ambiguous.
definition.name: ros1_rearrangement_status

definition.description: Patient's status regarding Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) infection.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if there is a laboratory test result or clinical diagnosis indicating an active or recent RSV infection in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no RSV testing or diagnostic documentation is present.
definition.name: rsv_infection_status

definition.description: Presence of metastatic disease in the scapula.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment record indicates the presence of metastasis in the scapula (e.g., 'known scapular metastasis', 'scapular metastasis').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation is absent or does not specify the presence or absence of scapular metastasis.
definition.name: scapular_metastasis

definition.description: The concentration of albumin in the patient's serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value for serum albumin from the pretreatment laboratory records, typically reported as part of a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the value is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: serum_albumin

definition.description: The concentration of bicarbonate in the patient's serum, typically measured as part of a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the serum bicarbonate level, typically listed as CO2 or HCO3 in the laboratory data section of the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the value is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: serum_bicarbonate

definition.description: The concentration of calcium in the patient's serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the most recent numeric value for serum calcium measured in mg/dL from the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If serum calcium is not documented or is ambiguous, return null.
definition.name: serum_calcium

definition.description: The concentration of chloride ions in the patient's serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value for serum chloride (often abbreviated as 'Cl') from the pretreatment laboratory records, typically found within a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the serum chloride measurement is missing or ambiguous.
definition.name: serum_chloride

definition.description: The concentration of creatinine in the blood serum, used as a primary indicator of renal function.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value for serum creatinine (often abbreviated as Cr or Creatinine) from the patient's laboratory results, typically reported within a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
definition.missing_value_rule: If serum creatinine is not documented or is ambiguously reported, represent the value as null.
definition.name: serum_creatinine

definition.description: The concentration of potassium in the patient's serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of serum potassium, typically listed as 'K' or 'Potassium' within a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP) or laboratory results section.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the value is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: serum_potassium

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
